description: The pie chart shows the distribution of data across six categories, with a legend titled “Categories” listing counts for each class and percentage labels displayed next to the slices. There are 6 slices: “chat” in pink/salmon at about 41.2% (legend count 546,526), “math” in blue at about 21.9% (290,496), “tooluse” in light green at about 11.6% (154,358), “multi turn chat” in light orange/peach at about 9.3% (123,615), “code” in light lavender/purple at about 9.0% (119,563), and “instruction follow” in light pink at roughly 6.9% (91,460). No slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments visually appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller proportions around the circle.
